description: This file defines the ParseRules class, which provides a static method getRules() that returns an array of rules, each associated with specific classes and file paths within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM project. It serves as a utility component involved in metadata rules processing.

classes.name: ParseRules
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to retrieve an array of rule configurations used in metadata processing within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Returns an array of rule definitions, each containing a class name and the corresponding file path where that class is implemented.
